mr_description:

* test(res.send): covered Transfer-Encoding and Content-Length headers logic

expected_issues.title: Gating the whole length-computation block on !Transfer-Encoding also skips the ETag gener…
expected_issues.description:
Gating the whole length-computation block on !Transfer-Encoding also skips the ETag generation path, so res.send with a pre-set Transfer-Encoding header loses its automatic ETag.

Provenance: fix PR #7459 body (commit 9a34acf0), which names introducing commit 18e5985b.
